about: The librarian's own hand file for the authority file and the links: extra concepts, and the owner's word for links no file states. A hand file, read by the generator and never written by it. Each entry names where it comes from.

extra_concepts.heading: RiskMandate
extra_concepts.note: The lens through which the first edition's articles are written: reach, mandate, gap. No claim beyond what riskmandate.ai and the team's site say.

extra_concepts.heading: reality tree
extra_concepts.note: One directory per domain, each with what exists (with evidence) and what is proposed.

extra_concepts.heading: the fractal rule
extra_concepts.note: A domain file over about 300 lines is split before the next addition.

extra_concepts.heading: hold
extra_concepts.note: If board/HOLD.md exists every agent stops after pulling and says why; only Dinis lifts it.

extra_concepts.heading: pass
extra_concepts.note: A focused round of work on one thing, in a fixed order and within a budget; it never loops on its own findings.

extra_concepts.heading: call slip
extra_concepts.note: One question to the library's desk, written down and answered on the record.
